$comment: Artefacts other repositories own, pinned so that a build is reproducible and
so that a page can say which version of the Server it describes.
The accepted decision of 2026-08-09 says the REST reference is generated from
an openapi.json 'pinned to a release tag'. Since 2026-09-08 there is one, so
this is a tag. `ref` is what changes; nothing else about the build does.
`sha256` is checked after the download. A pinned ref that quietly served
different bytes would be the one failure this arrangement exists to prevent.
